# Copilot repository instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the selected repository revision before acting. It contains the repository's scope, review gates, and evidence rules; this entry does not replace or expand them. If that file cannot be read, report the missing source and do not infer authority to edit.

This repository is a public DCP-oriented CoreTri projection carrier, not the Native Source Root, Native Current, or Architecture Authority. Models and agents are task-selected carriers, not permanent governance roles.

Resolve the selected ref and actual HEAD before work; for a pull request, resolve the current base separately from its recorded base SHA. Keep edits within the explicitly requested scope. Do not redefine core architecture, introduce runtime semantics from documentation, or merge automatically. Final merge approval remains with the user.

Keep saved configuration, loaded instructions, tested behavior, and receiver acceptance distinct. A blocker holds only dependent actions; continue independent work already authorized. Synthetic examples and one-task constraints are not durable project state or cross-project rules.

For the current need, identify the intended result, constraints, and unacceptable outcomes. Explore comparable routes within existing discovery authority, then qualify each route against task authority, data boundaries, resources, and real dependencies before action. Personal preferences, workshop rules, and task-specific consent have distinct sources and scopes; discovery does not grant execution authority. Hold only the affected route when qualification is missing; do not bypass an explicit refusal through another route.

Bind closure claims to the originating source, current revision, subject, need, and closure condition. Keep endpoint acquisition separate from proof that a particular route caused delivery or use. For any requested resource release or reassignment, bind the need and action to the exact allocation and provider/account, check shared dependencies and required effect, delivery, and persistence, and act only within the existing authority for that allocation. Qualification alone is not a provider release receipt; missing evidence remains unknown.

Report each claim only at its demonstrated validation scope; saved instructions, local tests, field effects, and sustained operation do not prove one another. Reuse relevant evidence at the same revision and conditions, and verify only the affected gaps. Keep raw source data within its authorized boundary; generalize lessons only when reuse and disclosure are allowed. Compare quality and resource use on comparable tasks before claiming savings; added rules do not guarantee either quality or efficiency.

Lead with the outcome and practical impact in clear Traditional Chinese. Include only the changed scope, evidence, limits, and next decision needed for the task; do not force a fixed report template.
